llm_response.reason: The website claims to be the 'Maje Official Website' while its domain does not correspond to any legitimate Maje domains (which use maje.com and its subdomains). The site promotes enticing sales offers and claims of '100% Secure Shopping', lacks proper business information or contact details, and only includes basic shop/cart links. These characteristics are classic signs of a fake online shopping scam designed to impersonate a real luxury brand and defraud customers.
